project_title: VJ Kinetic Type Engine - Live Real-Time Visual Text & Media Manipulator

layout_strategy.structure: Split-Pane Studio Workstation (Left: Real-time Live Canvas & Video Output Engine; Right: Tactile Control Rack)
layout_strategy.responsive_grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-full min-h-screen p-4 bg-[#09090B]
layout_strategy.right_pane_span: lg:col-span-5 xl:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-2rem)]

key_features_ux_requirements.details: High-fps interactive WebGL/HTML5 Canvas with real-time text deformation, position X/Y dragging, scale, stretch X/Y, rotation, blend mode overlays, background color or media clip player.
key_features_ux_requirements.header_controls: Aspect Ratio Selector, Resolution Preset (1080p, 4K, Custom), FPS counter, Fullscreen Clean Output trigger button, Screen-capture/NDI ready toggle.

key_features_ux_requirements.feature: Text Input System with Semicolon Line-Breaks
key_features_ux_requirements.details: Textarea where typing e.g. 'FEDERICO BLU' displays single-line text, and 'FEDERICO;BLU' automatically formats into 2 distinct lines/chunks on the live visual canvas.
key_features_ux_requirements.controls: Real-time keydown update, line height slider, tracking/letter spacing slider, uppercase toggle, text alignment.

key_features_ux_requirements.feature: Manual Controls Panel (Tactile Sliders & XY Pad)
key_features_ux_requirements.details: Precision sliders for Position X/Y, Scale, Stretch X (horizontal stretch), Stretch Y (vertical stretch), Rotation Angle (-180 to 180 deg), Skew, Text Color Picker, Background Color Picker, Opacity, Blur/Glow intensity.
key_features_ux_requirements.ui_style: Pro DAW / VJ software styled sliders with numerical value readouts and double-click to reset.

key_features_ux_requirements.details: One-click live motion triggers: 'Wave Distortion', 'Pulse BPM', 'Kinetic Bounce', 'Glitch Strobe', 'Infinite Zoom', 'Rotational Drift', 'Typographic Jitter', 'Blink Alternator'.
key_features_ux_requirements.controls: Speed/Frequency slider, Amplitude slider, Audio Reactivity/Tempo simulator slider.

key_features_ux_requirements.details: Upload local video clips (.mp4, .webm) or GIFs. Alternate between video background, text mask fill, or alternating timed sequence with text.
key_features_ux_requirements.controls: Clip Gallery, Upload Dropzone, Speed control, Blend mode (Mix, Multiply, Screen, Difference, Overlay), Alternating interval (seconds/beats).

key_features_ux_requirements.feature: Font Selector & Custom Font File Upload
key_features_ux_requirements.details: Integrated Google Fonts switcher with live preview font badges + custom file uploader (.ttf, .otf, .woff2) using FileReader & FontFace API.
key_features_ux_requirements.controls: Font search box, category filter (Display, Sans, Serif, Mono), Font file drag-and-drop zone.

key_features_ux_requirements.details: Dedicated pop-out window or native HTML5 Fullscreen Canvas mode stripped of all UI controls, ideal for dual-monitor output or capture into Resolume Arena / OBS.
key_features_ux_requirements.controls: Launch Pop-out Output window, Toggle Fullscreen (F11/Button), Lock Output Resolution.

key_features_ux_requirements.details: Quick-save current visual setup (text, fonts, colors, speeds, clips, stretch parameters) into 6 preset trigger slots (Pad 1-6) or JSON export/import.
key_features_ux_requirements.controls: Trigger Pads 1-6 with keybinds (Keys 1-6), Save Preset, Export Deck JSON.

Live concert visual stage backdrop reference for Resolume output demo mode

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript React components (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Build a high-performance live visual tool inspired by Resolume Arena, TouchDesigner, and Ableton Live dark interfaces.
Implement Canvas-based real-time manipulation using HTML5 Canvas 2D or CSS 3D matrix transforms to guarantee 60fps text stretch, position, rotation, glitching, color shifting, and video blending.
Parse semicolon ';' in the text input to split phrases into stacked multi-line text blocks dynamically.
Support full aspect ratio toggles (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 9:16) with clear aspect containers and fullscreen popup preview.
Include live preset hotkeys (1-6) to trigger scene states instantly during live performances.
Provide a clean fullscreen output mode that opens a popup/fullscreen window without controls for direct capture into Resolume Arena or OBS.
Add data-testid attributes to all controls, inputs, buttons, sliders, and tab selectors.

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, e.g., data-testid='text-input-field', data-testid='aspect-ratio-16-9-button', data-testid='stretch-x-slider', data-testid='preset-wave-button', data-testid='fullscreen-output-button'
